comment: The built-in types of the object registry (main/doc_page_impl_obj.md#built-in-types). Read by the service runtime kernel (service_object.py) and by the page (lib/doc-object-type.js); one file, so both registries agree. A type extends any number of types of its kind; core.object and core.relation are the roots.

typeList.label: Object
typeList.description: Anything the object registry can name: the root of every object type. A consumer that accepts core.object accepts every object, and draws it at least with the fallback view.

typeList.label: Collection
typeList.description: An object with members: the core.member relations from it, ordered, each entry with a key of its own (one object may be a member twice). Derived collections (the sections of a document, the results of a query) and explicit ones (a group) alike.

typeList.label: Group
typeList.description: An explicit collection: an identity and a lifecycle of its own, its members chosen by someone rather than derived from another structure.

typeList.label: Document
typeList.description: A text written for people to read.

typeList.label: Place
typeList.description: A place inside another object (a section of a document, a block). Its reference holds only while the structure of what contains it holds.

typeList.label: Configuration
typeList.description: Values that configure something. Its content is { valueByKey, defineList } (defineList: [{ key, type, default, description }]); an update is { valueByKey }, checked by the provider against the define list.

typeList.label: Task
typeList.description: Something to be done. Its summary says whether it is done (isDone); an update { isDone } checks it off or on, when the provider allows it.

typeList.label: File
typeList.description: Stored content of a media type, with a size.

typeList.label: Service
typeList.description: Something that runs and answers requests.

typeList.label: Doc page
typeList.description: A doc page of the workspace; its members are the root folders of its source.

typeList.label: Source folder
typeList.description: A folder of the source of a doc page; its members are its folders and files.

typeList.label: Markdown document
typeList.description: A .md or .mdx document of the workspace; its members are its top-level sections, known once the document is compiled.

typeList.label: Section
typeList.description: A heading of a document and what is under it, named by the fragment navigation uses (a declared id, else the heading's own id); its members are its sub-sections.

typeList.label: Component block
typeList.description: A component block of a document that declares an id.

typeList.label: Group in a document
typeList.description: A group declared by an ObjectGroup block: the document is its source of truth, so an edit of the document (by anyone, with any editor) changes or removes it; its members are the references the block lists.

typeList.label: Asset object
typeList.description: A versioned object of the asset service layer.

typeList.label: Service template
typeList.description: A service template of the backend: listed, never run.

typeList.label: Service instance
typeList.description: A service instance of the backend, app or infra.

typeList.label: Service config
typeList.description: The config of a service instance, provided by the kernel for every instance: read from its service.yaml, checked against its script's configDefineList, written back by an update (the instance restarts).

typeList.label: Relation
typeList.description: A relation from one object to another: the root of every relation type. Not every relation is an object; one that needs an identity, a state or a lifecycle of its own becomes an object instead.

typeList.label: Member
typeList.description: From a collection to one of its members. Each entry has a key of its own and an order, and may carry data of the entry (a duration on a timeline, a note in a group).

typeList.label: Contains
typeList.description: A member that exists only inside its container: structure (a section in a document, a file in a folder), not a choice.

typeList.label: Reference
typeList.description: From a place to an object it names (a link, an embed). The target may be gone: a reference is kept as written.

typeList.label: Document link
typeList.description: A reference written in a document, as the link index of the workspace keeps it (its line, block, headings and sentence are the data of the entry).

typeList.label: Created from
typeList.description: From a service instance to the template it was created from.

typeList.label: Depends on
typeList.description: From a service instance to the instance currently providing one of its infra dependencies (the infra name is the data of the entry).
